question: Why can an admin not use the module 'Homework' (endpoint /auth/login)?
answer: Check the user's role (must be admin) and the tab permissions in the settings. Endpoint /auth/login must be reachable (check server logs). On 401/403: check credentials and token. On 404: check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt. On 500: check the database and server logs.
